environment.description: Kubernetes deployment running the stream processor with BACKEND_PROXY_ADDR pointing to an nginx reverse proxy (nginx 1.18) that forwards to internal microservices. Feature flags are served by a local file-based provider with use_legacy_http_proxy=true and enable_chunked_forwarding=true hardcoded at build time. The nginx proxy does not normalize ambiguous requests and passes both Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding headers to the upstream, enabling CL/TE desync attacks.

config.proxy: nginx 1.18 with proxy_pass to upstream, no proxy_request_buffering off

feature_flags.provider: file-based JSON config baked into container image

config.network: flat pod network, no service mesh
